character_model.provider: openai (when OPENAI_API_KEY is set), else gemini

quiet_hours.note: Uses P1's isQuietHours(now(), facts.timezone, {demoMode, emergency}). Timezone comes from the facts snapshot.

moderator.clock: Quiet hours, daily cap, and digest time are evaluated on the shared now() (simulated time).
moderator.demo_mode: Bypasses quiet hours and uses daily_cap_proactive_demo_mode. Emergencies (priority 2) ignore both in every mode.

reply_classifier.rule: Only an unambiguous yes accepts. Anything mixed or unclear counts as not approved and gets a clarifying question.

number_checker.rule: Every number in a character message must equal a number in the facts snapshot or the plan (after normalization). Otherwise retry once if time allows, else send the template.

safety_rules: Agents never move money. They create a proposal; the user moves the money in their own bank.
Every number comes from the finance engine. The model only phrases it.
An unclear answer counts as no.
Never ask for passwords, one-time codes, PINs, SSNs, or account or card numbers.
No investment advice on specific securities. IRA talk stays at contribution and match level.
Never shame the user. Plain words, short messages, at most 2 sentences per character.
All data is synthetic; say so if asked.
